title: Luxury Girls Trip| Infinity Pool |Walk to Broadway
description:
🌸 Welcome to Cowgirl Dreams – Your Pink Paradise in Music City! 🤠🎀

Saddle up for a one-of-a-kind stay at Cowgirl Dreams, where Southern charm meets bold, girly glam in the heart of Nashville. Whether you're here for a bachelorette bash, a girls’ getaway, or just to live your best rhinestone-studded life, this vibrant & cozy space is made for memory-making.

Walkable to all of Music City's downtown restaurants, bars & attractions—Your private pink oasis above Nashville’s bright lights awaits!

The space
Short Term Rental Permit Number: #2025003347

LOCATION
Located at the the best apartment complex in the Gulch, you'll find the location of our building is in the perfect area of Downtown Nashville. Ready to Honky Tonk? Walk to Broadway in less than 20 minutes.  Catch breathtaking views of the Nashville skyline from the pool & tanning deck. Whether you're here for a Bachelorette or just looking to explore the city, you'll be living lavishly while you're here.

You'll be close to tons of chic restaurants & bars, and have a liquor store right next door. Walk to Broadway where you'll find everything Nashville, from bars to restaurants to Bridgestone Arena. Make sure to checkout the Music City Centre & Country Music Hall of Fame on the way. And just a short uber ride to Nissan Stadium & the Grand Ole Opry. 10 min drive to BNA Nashville International Airport. 15 min drive to Vanderbilt University.

BUILDING AMENITIES
- Infinity Pool & Tanning Deck
- Outdoor Kitchen, Terrace & Fire Pit
- Indoor & Outdoor Gym 
- Cycling Room & Yoga Studio 
- Music Recording Studio
- Pool Table
- Party Room 
- Rooftop Terrace

THE SPACE
Designed specially for your next girls trip, you'll find our pink oasis is perfectly set up to capture every moment. The first thing you'll notice is our disco wall with neon sign & stage. You can capture all your group pics with our selfie stick equipped with a ring light that has every feature to snap all your best angles. Grab a cowgirl hat, mic or guitar from our prop wall and rock out on stage! 

Ready for a night out on Broadway? Our make-up station in fully equipped with everything you need to get ready for the perfect night out.

The kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need for the chef in your group. Grab a coffee in the morning with from our Keurig machine with coffee included. Brita water purifier is located in the fridge as well. Get ready to pop some champagne to celebrate with champagne flutes included.

Want to relax after a day in the city? Our smart projector is easy to use, you can sign in to all your streaming services will connect to your phone through Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. And what's a movie night without popcorn included?

BEDROOMS
Our spacious 2 bedroom- 2 bathroom apartment comes with 4 beds. Primary bedroom has a king bed, secondary bedroom has 2 queen beds and living room has a pull out bed. Drift into dreamy sleep on our ultra-comfy memory foam mattresses, designed to contour to your body for the perfect night's rest. Each bedroom has a smart TV & plenty of closet space. Hair dryer & Steamer included in one of the bathrooms. You'll also find a washer & dryer available in the hall.

2 Key fobs provided to access the building, apartment, elevators & amenities.

NOW OFFERING FREE PARKING- 1 SPACE! Paid parking for additional vehicles available.

Bachlorette? Girls Trip? Birthday? Ask us about our partnership with local party guide:
From planning itineraries to decking out the Airbnb, we’re the one-stop shop for our groups’ party planning needs. You name it, we can do it! We partner with the best things to do in each city to ensure our groups have an unforgettable weekend and feel like the VIPs they are! We're located in Nashville, Charleston, 30A, and Austin and plan bachelor/bachelorette parties, birthday parties, anniversaries, corporate events, and more! 

The building's pool is a shared amenity managed by the property, and while it is typically open, it may close at any time without notice due to maintenance or other issues beyond our control. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer refunds in the event of pool closures. We appreciate your understanding!

We hope to see you soon!
